$Comment: Names the ziggfreedcommon:station_stat reading for requirement lines. Its Param is a stat and a station joined by @ (StationYield_Crafting@Sawmill), and it reads that stat as it would read at that station, counting the talents bound to working there even when the player is somewhere else: what a station's unattended pile, or an order collected away from the station, rolls with. The name covers the factor whatever stat and station a Param picks.
